<b>Hardbone Elders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are larger, more powerful [[Hardbone Hopper|Hardbone Hoppers]] that violently protect their smaller kin.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Hardbone Elders hop in similar manner to their younger counterparts, hopping idly, turning around at random, or pausing for 3 seconds to check behind themselves every few hops. Additionally, some Hardbone Elders start off resting, not wandering at all and instead supervising a [[Hardbone Hopper]]. If Hornet gets near, it will get up and begin its usual behaviour.<br>
However, they are aggressive if approached, and have two attacks depending on whether they're facing Hornet:
* <b>Mask Thrust:</b> Lunges forward, thrusting its face outwards and attacking with its sharp mask. 
* <b>Buck:</b> Kicks whatever is behind it in an upwards slashing motion.

Both attacks deal {{Damage|2}}, however contact damage only deals {{Damage|1}}.

They are best dodged by jumping over the Elder when in front of it, and backing away when behind it. It has few defenses from being attacked from above.

Sometimes [[Skarr Scout|Skarr Scouts]] can be seen attempting to hunt the Hardbone Elder, although it often kills them first.<br>
The 2nd one in the first room they are encountered in has 90 HP instead of 110 HP.

It should also be noted that Hardbone Elders respawn upon re-entering the room, despite their large size.
=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Hardbone Elders have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Hardbone Elders can be found in the northeast [[Far Fields]] during [[Act 3]], accessible from eastern [[Hunter's March]] with the [[Silk Soar]].
